title.narrative: Technical Cooperation Facility Mutiannual'Programme Estimate - Samoa

description.narrative: The overall objective to which the project, and therefore this Programme Estimate, are intended to contribute is to the implementation of the Strategy for the Development of Samoa through the support of sound development programmes financed from the 11th EDF. Project purpose - The purpose of the project, and therefore of this programme estimate, is to ensure an effective and efficient implementation and monitoring of actions under the 11th EDF National Indicative Programme including strengthening civil society organizations and the reforms under the Budget Support Programme.
